literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Presidential Library record identifies the 1922 Treaty and says it defined relations between republics and the center (L39-L43). The current key remains factually unique, but INITIAL’s defect is substantive: the named distractors are a 1918 peace treaty, 1905 imperial Manifest, and 1730 monarchical Conditions, so chronology and setting eliminate them without the target knowledge. The permitted retained evidence supplies no four comparable same-period competing instruments. No source-backed way to repair the frozen HARD criterion was established; HOLD the full card.
